    static int[] dist_arr = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] vis_arr = new boolean[MAXN];
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, v, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int v, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.v = v;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXN];
    static int[] head_arr = new int[MAXN];
    static int edge_idx = 1;

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int val, int cost) {
        edges[++edge_idx] = new Edge(to, head_arr[from], val, cost);
        head_arr[from] = edge_idx;
        edges[++edge_idx] = new Edge(from, head_arr[to], 0, -cost);
        head_arr[to] = edge_idx;
    }

    static boolean find_shortest_path() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = s; i <= t; ++i) {
            dist_arr[i] = INF_VAL;
            vis_arr[i] = false;
        }
        q.offer(s);
        dist_arr[s] = 0;
        vis_arr[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            vis_arr[x] = false;
            for (int i = head_arr[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int y = edges[i].to, c = edges[i].cost;
                if (dist_arr[y] <= dist_arr[x] + c || edges[i].v == 0) continue;
                dist_arr[y] = dist_arr[x] + c;
                if (!vis_arr[y]) {
                    vis_arr[y] = true;
                    q.offer(y);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_arr[t] != INF_VAL;
    }

    static int augment_flow(int x, int limit) {
        if (x == t) return limit;
        vis_arr[x] = true;
        int res = limit;
        for (int i = head_arr[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            int y = edges[i].to, v = edges[i].v;
            if (dist_arr[y] != dist_arr[x] + edges[i].cost || v == 0 || vis_arr[y]) continue;
            int f = augment_flow(y, Math.min(res, v));
            if (f > 0) {
                res -= f;
                edges[i].v -= f;
                edges[i ^ 1].v += f;
                if (res == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return limit - res;
    }

    static int compute_min_cost() {
        int total = 0, flow;
        while (find_shortest_path()) {
            while ((flow = augment_flow(s, INF_VAL)) > 0) {

        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {

        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        s = 0; // source node index
        t = (n * 110) + 1; // sink node index

        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            head_arr[i] = 0;
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) {
            add_edge(IDX(1, i), t, INF_VAL, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                add_edge(IDX(i, j), IDX(i, j + 1), INF_VAL, v1);
            }
        }

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            add_edge(s, IDX(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

                add_edge(IDX(y, j), IDX(x, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * l - 1) + v1);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_min_cost());
    }

    static int IDX(int x, int k) {
        return x + (k - 1) * n;
    }
}
